lines.text: I'm here. Are you calling me?
I'm still not very familiar with this place.
Being forced to fight non-stop is miserable.
Could these so-called Raptures be capable of peace?
This place is so peaceful. It's wonderful.
Er... What do I need to do?
I can't believe I'm seeing this! They only existed in books!
This is great. There are so many places to visit.
This place is huge, I can't even decide where to go first!
My name is Pascal. I'm a Machine Lifeform, and I despise fighting.
Now I have more strength to protect everyone.
I am grateful for your support.
Thanks, but... how exactly am I supposed to use this?
Can I do something for you?
Thanks to you, I have a deeper understanding of humans now.
It is an honor to meet someone as caring as yourself.
You want me to join you?
Stay clam... One at a time...
I have faith in you guys...
